summary: Ringwood State Park, NJ tower site: a 1920 Windbeam Mountain tower moved here in 1971, later destroyed by vandals; remains rebuilt at Ramapo Mountain State Forest from 1983.

facts.status_note: Tower destroyed by vandals at Pierson Ridge; its remains were rebuilt at Ramapo Mountain State Forest from 1983

access.note: On Ramapo Mountain State Forest land; the 2007 visit report says directions to the tower are not signed. No closure or climbing rule is described in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Do not publish under this id until the record is fixed. The id and region say WA, and the coordinates and 'Lorena Butte' other name belong to a different lookout (Lorena Butte, Klickitat County, WA; NHLR US 1549, WA 79). The tower described is the Pierson Ridge Tower Site in Ringwood State Park, NJ (FFLOS US 1549, NJ 1). Both registers number a site US 1549, which may explain the merge. Suggest a new id such as us-nj-pierson-ridge. The same tower also appears as the FFLOS Windbeam Lookout Site (US 1551, NJ 3) and the NHLR Ramapo Lookout (US 45, NJ 2), so the database may hold three records for one structure. Unresolved: the model (LS-42 on the Pierson entry, LS-40 on the Ramapo entry); the 60-foot figure is not confirmed as height to the cab floor, so height_m is left out; the record's elevation_m 698.3 matches no source read; the year the vandals destroyed the tower is not given, so no event is dated for it. Mapcarta puts Pierson Ridge in Bergen County, which conflicts with the FFLOS entry; not used. A 1919 newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts Ramapo page mentions a fire observation tower on the mountain near Midvale, before the 1920 build; not linked to this tower and not used. No new photos added.
